description: Bike and Pedestrian Counts Monitoring Locations is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. Daily bicycle and pedestrian counts are available from sensors set up on the Peace Bridge, cycle tracks and Stephen Avenue. Using an Eco-Counter machine, cyclists are detected using loops embedded in the pavement. The data provides the locations. The data for these locations is in the Bike and Pedestrian Counts dataset -. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are monitoring, location, counter. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2021-04-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
